pdf_only.direction: HAMILTONIAN PATH -> SPANNING TREE WITH <=42 LEAVES
pdf_only.convert_plan: New leaf-bounded spanning-tree endpoint: add universal start vertex s plus 41 degree-1 leaves; tree has >=41 leaves, total <=42 iff the original part is a spanning path from s.
New at-least-half-coverage path predicate: add n isolated vertices; a non-trivial long path lives in the original component, so covering >=half iff original has a Hamiltonian path.
New Tonian Cycle endpoint: universal closure vertex plus an isolated parity vertex; threshold ceil((n+2)/2)=ceil(n/2)+1; delete closure vertex from the cycle to get a long path.
New closed-walk predicate visiting every vertex exactly twice; must exclude spurious repeated-walk solutions.
Reuse weighted graph codec; weights chosen so a Hamiltonian cycle exists iff one of weight at least half the total edge weight exists.
Normalize to CliqueCover k=3 special case on the complement of the conflict graph; handle non-empty-group conditions.

Use the unweighted PDF 10 construction: normalize clauses so clause triangles share no edge, variable edges per x/not-x, clause triangles, threshold n+2m; PDF 14's weighted M=10m version is a WeightedMaxCut frontier.
pdf_only.promotion_conditions: Weights need a proven weight-to-unweighted adapter before reuse of the current endpoint.
